title: On the Limits of Stochastic Push-Pull over Time-Varying Digraphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32422v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic Push-Pull achieves linear speedup with respect to the network size $n$ on static strongly connected digraphs, but whether this speedup persists on time-varying networks remains unclear. In this work, we construct a quadratic decentralized problem on period-two networks showing that stochastic Push-Pull may fail to attain linear speedup over time-varying digraphs. For $p$-periodic networks, we identify an effective node count $n_{\mathrm{eff}}\le n$ that governs the leading stochastic term. Specifically, for smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence upper bounds and matching lower bounds for stochastic Push-Pull with constant stepsizes, both exhibiting the leading-order dependence $\Theta(1/\sqrt{n_{\mathrm{eff}} T})$. translated_title: 关于时变有向图上随机Push-Pull算法的极限
translated_abstract: 随机Push-Pull算法在静态强连通有向图上能够实现关于网络规模 $n$ 的线性加速，但这种加速是否在时变网络上依然成立尚不清楚。在本工作中，我们在周期为二的网络上构造了一个二次型去中心化优化问题，表明随机Push-Pull在时变有向图上可能无法获得线性加速。对于 $p$-周期网络，我们确定了一个有效节点数 $n_{\mathrm{eff}}\le n$，它支配着主导的随机项。具体而言，对于光滑非凸目标函数，我们建立了采用恒定步长的随机Push-Pull的收敛上界和匹配下界，两者均呈现 $\Theta(1/\sqrt{n_{\mathrm{eff}} T})$ 的主导阶依赖关系。当 $p=1$ 时，恒等式 $n_{\mathrm{eff}}=n$ 恢复了静态有向图上通常的线性加速；然而，周期网络可能存在 $n_{\mathrm{eff}}=o(n)$，从而证明了线性加速的丧失。
tldr: 本文通过构造周期网络上的反例并建立匹配的收敛上下界，证明了随机Push-Pull算法在时变有向图上可能失去线性加速，其随机收敛率由有效节点数 $n_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 而非网络规模 $n$ 主导。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that stochastic Push-Pull may lose linear speedup over time-varying digraphs by constructing a counterexample and establishing matching convergence bounds showing the rate is governed by an effective node count $n_{\mathrm{eff}}$ rather than the network size $n$.
